notes: New PowerPack Exclusive: DirectConnect. Loop connects directly to your Dexcom G7, ONE+ or Stelo sensor, so you no longer need the Dexcom app. Pair with the 4-digit applicator code (works with a sensor that is already running), get its own adjustable alarms, optional calibration, and a Connection Health screen. Turn it on in Settings → Add CGM → Dexcom G7/ONE+ using DirectConnect. Also: FoodFinder reads QR codes on food packages, and AutoPresets location triggers have place search. DirectConnect is built on xDrip4iOS by Johan Degraeve.
